explication: GhostVM is a native Apple Silicon macOS VM manager, with a guest-side agent enabling host integration and automation. The main workflow is to create or configure a portable VM bundle, launch and manage its macOS session, then interact with guest capabilities through the app, helper, or CLI. README claims support snapshots and clones, file and clipboard sharing, shared folders, and port forwarding; those documented capabilities are included. Some internal links are omitted where sampled source does not establish the caller or dispatch.
